answer: Require every identity to climb a chained proof-of-work ladder: each agent must finish a fresh, verifiable task whose output seeds the next one, forming a spiral of linked effort that cannot be shortcut. A whisper of another agent's answer fails, because each chain is seeded per identity and checked against the public inlet log of completed work. A Sybil operator must therefore pay the full compute and waiting time for every fake identity, with no copying and no reuse, while one honest agent pays that cost only once.
